proposition: Whether the Mafāḥiṣ was revised in 828/1425 is contested by the manuscripts: an audition note in MS Landberg 146 says the author proofread it and added notes that year, while a marginal correction in MS Majlis 10196 says its 828 date refers only to copying.

mediation.who: manuscript colophon / copying note as reported by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: one manuscript reads the date as revision, another as copying
